source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.5 with Fig. 9.16 and Examples 9.4 and 9.5 (PDF 202-204).

blocks.text: Fig. 9.16 mein do parallel (mutawazi) plates hain jin par ulte charges hain; yeh plates apne darmiyan uniform electric field banati hain.

blocks.alt: Do horizontal (ufuqi) plates: oopar B (+), neeche A (-), faasla d. Magenta lines seedhi neeche. Darmiyan chhota charge +q, hara teer F oopar aur surkh teer qE neeche.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.16 (kitab ki Figure 9.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Field +q ko neeche (A ki taraf) dhakelti hai: force qE. Charge ko A se B tak barabar speed (raftar) se le jane ke liye barabar aur ulti force F = qE oopar lagani parti hai; yahi kaam charge ki potential energy barhata hai.

Is uniform field mein ek positive (musbat) charge q ko azaad chhor dein to woh plate B se A ki taraf chalega aur kinetic energy (K.E.) hasil karega. Agar ise A se B le jana ho to field ke khilaf chalane ke liye bahar se force lagani paregi, aur charge potential energy (P.E.) hasil karega. Condition (shart) yeh rakhte hain ke charge A se B tak electrostatic equilibrium (barabari ki halat) mein rahe, yani uniform (ek jaisa) velocity se chale. Iske liye raste ke har point par qE ke barabar aur ulti force F lagate hain. Field ke khilaf bahar wali force jo kaam karti hai, woh charge ki electrical potential energy barha deti hai.
Maan lein W_AB woh kaam hai jo force charge q ko equilibrium mein rakhte hue A se B tak le jane mein karti hai. Phir potential energy mein tabdeeli ΔU = W_AB, yani:
Yahan U_A aur U_B points A aur B par potential energies hain.

Electric field ko describe karne ke liye potential difference ka idea (khayal) laate hain. Do points A aur B ka potential difference woh kaam hai jo ek unit positive charge ko equilibrium mein rakhte hue A se B tak le jane mein hota hai:
Yahan V_A aur V_B points A aur B par electric potentials hain. Potential energy ka farq aur potential ka farq aapas mein yun jure hain:

blocks.title: Kya aap jaante hain? (Do You Know?)
blocks.text: ECG insaan ki skin (jild) ke points ke darmiyan woh “voltage” record karti hai jo dil ke electrical process (amal) se banta hai. Daurte hue li gayi ECG batati hai ke stress (dabao) mein dil kaisa kaam karta hai.

blocks.alt: Pink graph paper par ECG trace: seedhi baseline par chaar dafa dil ki dhadkan (heartbeat) ka ek hi pattern: pehle chhota gol ubhaar, phir oonchi patli spike (dono taraf chhoti dip ke saath), phir chaura gol ubhaar.
blocks.caption: Do You Know? box ki ECG trace (kitab ki bina caption wali tasveer ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Yani potential difference = har unit charge ki potential energy ka farq.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har dhadkan (heartbeat) par trace ek hi shakal dohrati hai: chhota ubhaar, oonchi tez spike, phir chaura ubhaar. Spike ki oonchai dil ke electrical signal ka voltage (potential difference) dikhati hai, aur do spikes ka faasla batata hai ke dil kitni tezi se dhadak raha hai.
P.E. ki unit joule hai, is liye Eq. 9.17 se potential difference ki unit joule per coulomb hai. Ise volt kehte hain:
Yani do points ke darmiyan 1 volt ka potential difference tab hai jab 1 coulomb positive charge ko equilibrium mein rakhte hue ek point se doosre tak le jane mein 1 joule kaam ho.

Kisi ek point ka potential batane ke liye ek reference point chahiye jise zero potential dete hain; aam taur par yeh infinity (bohat door) par liya jata hai. Eq. 9.17 mein A ko infinity par lein aur V_A = 0 rakhein to B ka potential V_B = W_AB/q hoga. Aam taur par:

blocks.title: Ghaur karein (Point to ponder)
blocks.text: Electric appliances (bijli ki cheezein) chalate waqt rubber ke talwon (soles) wale joote pehnne ka mashwara kyun diya jata hai?

Yani kisi point ka electric potential woh kaam hai jo ek unit positive charge ko equilibrium mein rakhte hue infinity se us point tak lane mein hota hai. Is liye har point ka potential infinity ke muqable mein hota hai. Potential aur potential difference dono scalar hain, kyun ke W aur q dono scalar hain.
